scripts.server:lint: uv run --project apps/server ruff check apps/server && uv run --project apps/server mypy --config-file apps/server/pyproject.toml apps/server/app
scripts.audio-quality:check: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/audio_quality/tests -p 'test_*.py' && uv run --project apps/server ruff check scripts/audio_quality && uv run --project apps/server mypy --config-file apps/server/pyproject.toml scripts/audio_quality
scripts.protocol:generate: uv run --project apps/server python apps/server/scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript apps/server/openapi.json -o packages/protocol/src/openapi.ts
scripts.protocol:check: corepack pnpm protocol:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/server/openapi.json packages/protocol/src/openapi.ts
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm server:lint && corepack pnpm server:test && corepack pnpm audio-quality:check && corepack pnpm build
